== Description == <!--T:2-->

<!--T:3-->
The [[Image_Open|Image Open]] tool simply opens an image from your system in a new tab in the viewport.

== Usage == <!--T:4-->

<!--T:5-->
# Press the {{Button|[[Image:Image_Open.svg|16px]] [[Image_Open|Image Open]]}} button.
# Select the image file that you want.

<!--T:6-->
The image is placed in a new viewport, not in the 3D view.
